searchText: what do you need from them... I suspect for any of these things you can just tag "at"-prysmatic and we'd be happy. We all monitor most channels here anyway. If it is for your usual pressuring on timelines, then you can put <@531934490826768418> from Prysm cause anyway he's already gotten used from Fusaka 😛 We had genesis 4h ago on fusaka-devnet-4. Its a very large network, so any changes on it will take a while to roll out. Please keep an eye on it, and let us know if you need some new image rolled out. Watchtower is disabled on it. The usual links are available under https://fusaka-devnet-4.ethpandaops.io We also don't have dns names setup for each node, as this would exceed the limitations of cloudflare, We have dns setup for all nodes -1, -2, -3 ending. Otherwise if you want to ssh into a host you can do it directly using it's [ip address](https://github.com/ethpandaops/fusaka-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-4/inventory.ini). Also we now use full/super prefix in the names, so host names are: `teku-besu-full-1` Fulu will be activated approx a day from now. We have constant tx and blob spamming (in public mempool) Sunnyside Labs is delighted to be participating in fusaka-devnet-4, running around 400 fullnodes (229 Lighthouse-Geth & 168 Prysm-Geth). We're also excited to welcome <@&975128594101702746> to the devnet - we'll be operating additional nodes on their behalf as part of this collaboration (potentially as non-validator nodes). Alongside EthPandaOps, we'll also be actively analyzing and debugging throughout the run. Looking forward to such a mega-devnet!!
